definitions.gloss: regarding as important; placing importance on; emphasizing
definitions.explanation: The act of treating something as significant or giving it priority. Used in formal and written contexts.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{安全|あんぜん}を{重要視|じゅうようし}している。
examples.english: This company places great importance on safety.

examples.japanese: {教育|きょういく}を{重要視|じゅうようし}する{国|くに}は{経済|けいざい}も{発展|はってん}しやすい。
examples.english: Countries that prioritize education tend to develop economically as well.

examples.japanese: {近年|きんねん}、ワークライフバランスが{重要視|じゅうようし}されるようになってきた。
examples.english: In recent years, work-life balance has come to be regarded as important.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {重要|じゅうよう} (important) + {視|し} (to regard/view). The passive form {重要視|じゅうようし}される (to be regarded as important) is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重要視|じゅうようし}する (to regard as important)
- {重要視|じゅうようし}される (to be regarded as important)
- {重要視|じゅうようし}されている (is considered important)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {重視|じゅうし}する: to emphasize, to value — shorter and more common synonym
- {大切|たいせつ}にする: to value, to cherish — more everyday/casual
